Andrés de Jesús María y José Bello López ( Spanish pronunciation: [anˈdɾes ˈβeʝo] ; November 29, 1781 – October 15, 1865) was a Venezuelan humanist , diplomat, poet, legislator, philosopher , educator and philologist , whose political and literary works constitute an important part of Spanish American culture. [ 1 ] Bello is featured on the old 2,000 Venezuelan bolívar and the 20,000 Chilean peso notes.
